title: 1.8 What they don't do
unit_outcome: Describe people and family, say what people do every day and how often, and ask about other people’s habits.
goal: Say what you and other people don't do as a habit, with don't and doesn't (I don't cook dinner. / Diego doesn't cook dinner.), next to what they do (Ana cooks dinner.).
grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 1.8 What They Are Not Doing: A1 says what people are not doing right now (He is not cooking.); A1+ 1.8 says what they don't do as a habit. The one new grammar relationship is don't/doesn't + the base verb: A1's I do not becomes I don't, and he/she takes doesn't, which takes the -s off the verb (Diego doesn't cook dinner.). Listen sets it against A1's is not ...-ing (Diego is not cooking dinner.).
prerequisite: A1 1.7-1.8 cooking and not; A1 4.8 and 5.5 I do not; A1 5.7 dinner; A1 2.1 restaurant; A1 4.10 in the evening; A1 7.6 watch TV; A1+ 1.2 he/she -s (cooks, eats).
speaking_outcome: Say don't and doesn't clearly, with the final t light but present, and keep the verb without -s after doesn't (doesn't cook). Do not require native-like speed.
